mobile.description: Defines if the IP is part of a known cellular network.

source_country.description: Country where the IP address is registered or operates.

source_country_code.description: Country code of the IP address based on ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

source_city.description: The city where the device is geographically located.

region.description: The region where the device is geographically located.

organization.description: The name of organization that owns the IP address.

category.description: The subset of network types the IP address belongs to.

os.description: An approximate guess of the operating system of the device, based on the TCP stack fingerprint.

items.description:
The full name or country code where GreyNoise sensor
is physically located.

The country codes where GreyNoise sensor is
physically located.
The city where the GreyNoise sensor is geographically located.
The ASN associated with the destination IP address.

single_destination.description:
A Boolean parameter indicating whether the source IP address
has only been observed in a single destination country.

carrier.description:
The Internet Service Provider (ISP) or telecommunications
carrier associated with the source IP address.

datacenter.description:
The datacenter or hosting provider from which the activity originates.
This could indicate the use of cloud services,
managed hosting, or enterprise datacenter infrastructure.

domain.description: The domain name associated with the source IP address.

rdns_parent.description:
The parent domain retrieved through reverse DNS (RDNS)
lookup of the source IP address.

rdns_validated.description:
A validation status that confirms whether the reverse DNS (RDNS)
record correctly maps to the source domain.

latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the source IP address.

longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the source IP address.

sensor_count.description: Number of sensors with events observed.
